title: Turned walnut bowl
description: A face-grain serving bowl turned from a 10 × 4 inch walnut blank: an even 7 mm wall from a rounded rim to a foot ring with a dovetailed chuck recess, with its capacity in millilitres.

difficulty.rationale: One constrained spline revolved, its inside an exact offset written as a formula curve, two fillets, closed-form checks by Pappus and Steiner.

materials: Black walnut (Juglans nigra), kiln dried, oiled

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: deep document.check ok, its own 7 assertions pass at five parameter points; 453.735 cm3 of wood, 290.39 g, 1839.68 mL brimful and the foot ring 14 493.1773 mm3, equal to this example's; Steiner's wall check within 0.03 mm3; about 100 commands. It measured the capacity with a hidden helper body (F-047) and placed the pith a little differently.
